tour.label: Welcome tour
tour.welcomeBody: A 30-second tour shows you where everything is.
tour.menuBody: The menu button opens every screen of your role.
tour.searchBody: Press Ctrl+K (or ⌘K) anywhere to search students, exams and classes or run an action.
tour.bellBody: New messages and exams arrive here live. In settings you can also choose email or push.
tour.studentPracticeBody: In "Practice questions" pick a topic and practice. You can save questions and practice offline.
tour.teacherTestsBody: In "Create an exam" you build an exam, and your students are notified right away.
tour.managerSetupBody: Start with grades and classes, then add teachers and assign students.
tour.adminSchoolsBody: Register a new school and assign it a manager from the menu.
tour.finish: That's it! You can replay the tour from settings.

offline.banner: You are offline. Practice continues, and answers sync when you are back online.
offline.noCached: No saved questions for this topic. Go online and save some first.
offline.queued: Answer saved. It will be checked when you are back online.
